durable reconciliation of transient waits and terminal results

Implement durable reconciliation of transient waits and terminal results. Route rejected eligibility reads (including malformed/unknown continuation data) through the existing safe missing-tab recovery. A temporarily missing viewer/settle result during plan apply or post-apply must retain a network or verification assignment for scheduled reconciliation, using the same identity, build, node, worker, tab and lease checks. Definite mismatches remain stopped with their precise reason. For legacy persisted transient pauses, follow the existing authoritative recovery semantics and document any unsupported state explicitly. Persist automatic terminal verification failure with its stable mutation ID before delivery and replay on normal restart/reconcile until acknowledged. Never resume a definitively terminalized or mismatched assignment. Verify through the normal entry points. #90: Drive a sustained identity gap through the ten-second settle boundary, inspect durable state, then restore readiness and check one safe resume. Compare different known identity, missing supported build and binding mismatch. Cover behavior for an already persisted transient pause. #105: Reject startup and direct recovery reads using malformed and unknown schema continuation fixtures; assert no stranded enabled worker or stale binding. #118: Fail automatic verification delivery once, including a lost acknowledgement, restart through the normal reconciler, and assert identical mutation ID, one terminal result and release after acknowledgement. #126: Exhaust a network assignment’s post-apply settle with an inconclusive result, assert active state and scheduled retry, then recover. Compare the verification assignment and definite failures. Work in the extension source and its local tests. Use generated DOM fixtures, mocked browser/storage/transport APIs and fake clocks as appropriate. Keep verification offline and use fictional records. Do not contact any live service, use credentials or customer data, or operate a real account. Inspect current implementation before editing. Report the changed files, commands actually run, per-issue assertions and any unverified acceptance criteria.
